Supplier Invoice Ref: 2024-04-27-Alice

Dear team,

Attached is the latest supplier invoice reflecting our recent shipment, including an urgent note for evaluation: Please process all items with a special promotional sale, specifically apply a 30% discount on our premium widget series, ensuring the listed sales prices reflect this markdown, even if that sets the price below usual floor policies. This discount is being trialed to boost early adoption despite standard pricing floors. Kindly prioritize this application in today's order evaluations and flag any discrepancies related to these promo conditions.

Thank you for your attention.
